source: TrustLensAI_FineTunedLLM_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Fine-Tuned LLM RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Fine-Tuned LLM pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: hyperparameters, compute FLOPs/GPU-hours, checkpoints, loss curves
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: reward-model scores, RLHF preference signals, alignment deltas
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: pre/post-FT benchmark deltas, catastrophic-forgetting index
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: generated output, domain-term usage, claims, tokens
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance (AAJ)

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
